# Copy/paste coding-assistant prompts

## T01 kickoff — PLAN ONLY

You are working in the ForgeQuote repository. Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/current-status.md`, `docs/requirements.md`, `docs/costing-spec.md`, `docs/golden-cases.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/decisions/`, and `tasks/T01-thin-slice.md`.

**Do not edit any file yet.** First provide a concise T01 implementation plan with: (1) files and directories, (2) SQL tables, constraints and rate version references, (3) exact endpoint contracts, (4) decimal arithmetic and rounding, (5) tests from golden cases, (6) deployment plan and environment variables, (7) risks and assumptions. Keep it a thin deployed vertical slice, not full assignment. Wait for my explicit approval before coding. Do not claim any feature is implemented or deployed without running the required checks.

## Handoff prompt (after each task)

Show: feature branch and commits; changed files; commands/tests run and actual results; demo instructions; database migration impact; deployment URL/status; known gaps; remaining CORE requirements; update current-status/learning-log/ADRs; ask me three questions testing my understanding. Do not merge without approval.
